item.description: - Find on this page now appears at the foot of the page, just above the address, in place of the top. - Closing Find no longer leaves the last word it found highlighted on the page. - The top row and the frame round the page are plain white again, in place of the glass. - The address of a link you were pointing at no longer stays in the corner after the next page has opened. - When you scroll down, the top row still slides away at once, but the thin border round the page now waits until you've stopped scrolling before it goes. The page no longer widens and nudges the words while you're moving.
